prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Completely RECOMPOSE and repaint the garden picnic ending as ONE COHERENT ENVIRONMENT ILLUSTRATION, using the reference ONLY for the identities and hand-painted storybook style of the girl, fairy, oak tree, teddy bear with teal bandana, green plush dinosaur, red toy robot, little red-green train, orange juice and toasted bread. The previous reference composition was REJECTED because blanket and toys still look suspended. Do NOT preserve its composition, cliff edge, sprite collage look or object placements. New scene: a spacious sunlit grassy clearing, a large rooted oak on the LEFT, a compact picnic gathering on the RIGHT, small girl approaching from lower left and fairy hovering naturally beside her. White garden fence, flowers and distant lush garden remain softly painted in background. CRITICAL: the lower HALF of the whole picture is ONE broad uninterrupted gently receding grassy GROUND PLANE seen from a consistent modestly elevated three-quarter camera angle. No vertical platform wall, no cliff edge, no shelf, no floating island, no thin ground line. Clearly show ample foreground grass IN FRONT OF, BEHIND and AROUND all four edges of the picnic blanket. The tree roots sink into this very same grassy ground plane, with embedded stones and grass growing around them. The picnic blanket is a SMALL thin crumpled pale cream/peach/blue checked fabric laid directly on the grass, following slight ground unevenness. Its four corners visibly touch and partly disappear into little surrounding grass blades; front edge lies INSIDE the meadow, well away from image boundary. No stretched pristine rectangular flying carpet, no raised lip or underside, no dark gap beneath cloth. Draw irregular soft cloth folds lying flat, low localized occlusion at cloth/grass contacts, blades partly over fringe. Leave a clear visible strip of uninterrupted meadow between the rightmost tree roots and the nearest blanket edge; nothing intersects tree trunk or roots. Teddy, dinosaur and robot sit ON this cloth with their complete bottom/haunches and feet visibly weighted into fabric, compressing small folds. Train WHEELS visibly rest on cloth; plates and jug have contact shadows at their bases and correct shared perspective. Use a truly consistent perspective for ground, blanket, toys and plates, with subtle light from upper left and all shadows falling in the same direction across the grass. Their cast shadows merge naturally into the grass/cloth, no detached oval shadows floating below. Keep picnic ensemble compact and toy-sized relative to girl, avoid giant toys dominating scene. Maintain toasted bread and a modest orange juice jug/glasses, no extra dishes or characters. The tree is clearly separate from the picnic, canopy may cast gentle shade onto clearing but no leaves cover toy bodies. Paint everything together with the SAME brushwork, lighting, edge softness and scale of detail; objects must look physically present in the meadow rather than pasted cutout sprites. Wide landscape final-game narrative tableau, serene warm daylight, no text, no UI, no arrows, no borders. The purpose is a visual sample of a fully integrated grounded environment, not an implementation screenshot.
estado: Proposta de cena final ilustrada integral em clareira, com chão compartilhado e gramado ao redor da toalha. Nova câmera/composição apenas na amostra; sem alteração de câmera ou física no jogo. Aguarda avaliação humana.
